description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of databases in a data lake. You can match databases by name
description_zh: 获取数据湖中数据库列表，分页查询，可以根据数据库名称匹配
name: ListDatabases

parameters.help_en: The namespace for database categorization. By default, this is the UID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 数据库分类命名空间，默认填写主账号Uid
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.help_en: A regular expression that matches database names. To match all databases, enter .*
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名称匹配的正则表达式，全部匹配则传入.*
parameters.name: name_pattern

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. This is returned in the response. For the first page, pass an empty string ("")
parameters.help_zh: 翻页token，由结果返回，如第一页可传入""
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size
